subject: [PATCH v2 3/3] mm/swap: skip relocation of tableless clusters

2026-11-10.patch_summary: This patch prevents a stale reclaimer from freeing a tableless swap cluster while an allocator is still populating its table. This occurs when the allocator drops its locks to populate the table, allowing the reclaimer to reach the relocation code and potentially dereference NULL in the DEBUG_VM empty check. The patch adds a check to skip relocation of tableless clusters, leaving them for the allocator under the cluster's lock. This prevents a FREE-to-NONE state cycle and ensures that the table population is completed before the cluster is freed.
